text:
mike: Heads up — ACME reported intermittent 503s to the private VPC endpoint after our cert rotation last night. They see bursts of failures for ~30s every 10–15m.
elaine: Can you paste the client logs or curl output?
mike: Here's a snippet from their client: 
```
curl -v https://private.acme.internal/api/health --resolve private.acme.internal:443:10.4.0.12
* Connected to private.acme.internal (10.4.0.12) port 443 (#0)
* TLS 1.2 connection using ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
* server certificate verification failed. CAfile: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.crt \n  CRLfile: none\n* Closing connection 0
```
ranjit: That looks like a validation error. Any more detail from the server side?
mike: From their network team: failures correlate with the k8s node that has an egress policy blocking outbound 80/443 to ocsp.*.acme-ca.com — when the node can't reach OCSP stapling endpoints our nginx/haproxy sometimes times out on stapled responses.
elaine: Wait — our rotator pushed the new leaf but the bundle lacked the intermediate in one AZ. We rolled a fix but if OCSP checks are blocked the client will require the full chain or stapled response. If staple times out, some clients reject.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-477 — "Private endpoint intermittent cert validation". Pager duty notified. :rotating_light:
natalie: Repro steps I ran from my laptop (no egress blocks):
1) openssl s_client -connect private.acme.internal:443 -status
2) Observe OCSP response stanza and certificate chain length
```
openssl s_client -connect private.acme.internal:443 -status
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
...leaf...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
OCSP Response Status: successful (0x0)
Chain: leaf -> intermediate -> root
```
ranjit: And when I simulate a blocked ocsp host (iptables DROP) I see no OCSP stapling and the server still sends a trimmed chain (leaf only). Client then fails with "certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate".
elaine: So two independent issues: (A) rotator pushed an incomplete bundle to one AZ (fixed already), (B) when OCSP egress is blocked haproxy/nginx falls back and sometimes serves only leaf. We should fix fallback to always include full chain even if stapling fails.
mike: Agreed. Immediate mitigation for customer: 1) confirm they whitelist our OCSP endpoints in their egress allowlist, 2) rotate server cert again with full CA bundle, 3) restart proxy processes on nodes that showed failures (to purge any cached partial bundles).
natalie: Command I used to check the chain that exposed the problem: 
```
openssl s_client -showcerts -connect private.acme.internal:443 | sed -n '/BEGIN CERTIFICATE/,/END CERTIFICATE/p'
```
elaine: I'll file a follow-up with infra: update rotator to validate bundle contents in post-deploy (assert intermediate present), and change proxy config so cert file path points to the full-bundle file even on OCSP staple failure. Also add a retry/backoff around stapling fetch to avoid transient timeouts.
ranjit: For the patch we can: 
- Add post-deploy check: `openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/full-bundle.pem /etc/ssl/certs/leaf.pem`
- Ensure HAProxy config uses `ssl crt /etc/ssl/certs/full-bundle.pem` not a symlink to the leaf only.
mike: I've scheduled a maintenance window with ACME to rotate again after we push the rotator change. ETA 2h.
elain[e]: FYI @natalie please include the customer's egress ACL rule sample when you confirm whitelisting, they had a very restrictive policy.
natalie: Will do, sending example: `allow tcp 10.4.0.0/16 -> ocsp.acme-ca.com:80`
oncall-bot: INC-2026-477 updated: assigned to eng-ssl; priority elevated to P1 due to production errors.
elaine: Thanks — I'll own the rotator patch and port the verify hook to the private deployer. Keep me posted on the maintenance outcome. :thumbsup:"
